all.description: Rules that must all match the node.

any.description: Rules of which at least one must match the node.

follows.description: Rule an earlier sibling node must match.

has.description: Rule a contained node must match.

inside.description: Rule an enclosing node must match.

kind.description: AST node kind to match.

matches.description: Identifier of a reusable rule to match.

not.description: Rule the node must not match.

context.description: Source pattern containing the node to select.

selector.description: Node kind selected from the context pattern.

strictness.description: Controls trivia and token sensitivity for the contextual pattern.

pattern.description: Source pattern or contextual pattern to match.

precedes.description: Rule a later sibling node must match.

regex.description: Regular expression matched against node text.

stopBy.description: Boundary for relational matching: neighbor, end, or a matching rule.

AR_allowSyntaxRegression.description: Permit new parse errors during preview staging and apply; otherwise syntax regressions abort before file changes.

AR_apply.description: Apply verified proposed edits when true. Preview may recover an interrupted transaction but does not apply proposed edits.

AR_exclude.description: Globs removed after include filtering beneath path.

AR_expectedHashes.description: Preview SHA-256 hashes for exactly the selected files; with selectedMatchIds omit hashes for unselected files.

expandEnd.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement end boundary.

expandStart.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement start boundary.

template.description: Replacement template applied to each selected match.

AR_fix.description: Replacement text or structured ast-grep fix configuration.

AR_include.description: Globs evaluated beneath path before exclusions.

AR_maxFiles.description: Maximum files inspected before returning partial state.

AR_maxMatches.description: Maximum matches collected before returning partial state.

AR_page.description: Copy from next.* when preview results span multiple pages.

AR_pageSize.description: Lower this to keep each preview response small.

AR_path.description: Absolute source file or directory path.

AR_postconditions.description: Checks that must pass after the rewrite or the write is rolled back.

equals.description: Required remaining match count after apply.

kind.description: Check matches remaining in the staged selected files before committing.

AR_selectedMatchIds.description: Optional preview match IDs to apply; omitted applies every unchanged match.

AR_snapshot.description: Preview snapshot digest required by apply.

id.description: Correlation key preserved across every result in the batch.

question.description: One classification axis evaluated independently for each resource page.

criteria.description: Optional, complete true/false definitions. Omit the object or provide both keys.

false.description: Evidence or condition that counts as no; null is provider-supported.

true.description: Evidence or condition that counts as yes; null is provider-supported.

instructions.description: Ask one decision-linked judgment and front-load the deciding context from your current analysis (hypothesis, constraint, decision at stake) — the provider sees only state, instructions, and criteria; do not hide a checklist or request free-form analysis.

tools.name: lspSearch

all.description: Rules that must all match the node.

any.description: Rules of which at least one must match the node.

follows.description: Rule an earlier sibling node must match.

has.description: Rule a contained node must match.

inside.description: Rule an enclosing node must match.

kind.description: AST node kind to match.

matches.description: Identifier of a reusable rule to match.

not.description: Rule the node must not match.

context.description: Source pattern containing the node to select.

selector.description: Node kind selected from the context pattern.

strictness.description: Controls trivia and token sensitivity for the contextual pattern.

pattern.description: Source pattern or contextual pattern to match.

precedes.description: Rule a later sibling node must match.

regex.description: Regular expression matched against node text.

stopBy.description: Boundary for relational matching: neighbor, end, or a matching rule.

AR_allowSyntaxRegression.description: Permit new parse errors during preview staging and apply; otherwise syntax regressions abort before file changes.

AR_apply.description: Apply verified proposed edits when true. Preview may recover an interrupted transaction but does not apply proposed edits.

AR_exclude.description: Globs removed after include filtering beneath path.

AR_expectedHashes.description: Preview SHA-256 hashes for exactly the selected files; with selectedMatchIds omit hashes for unselected files.

expandEnd.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement end boundary.

expandStart.description: Optional rule that expands the replacement start boundary.

template.description: Replacement template applied to each selected match.

AR_fix.description: Replacement text or structured ast-grep fix configuration.

AR_include.description: Globs evaluated beneath path before exclusions.

AR_maxFiles.description: Maximum files inspected before returning partial state.

AR_maxMatches.description: Maximum matches collected before returning partial state.

AR_page.description: Copy from next.* when preview results span multiple pages.

AR_pageSize.description: Lower this to keep each preview response small.

AR_path.description: Absolute source file or directory path.

AR_postconditions.description: Checks that must pass after the rewrite or the write is rolled back.

equals.description: Required remaining match count after apply.

kind.description: Check matches remaining in the staged selected files before committing.

AR_selectedMatchIds.description: Optional preview match IDs to apply; omitted applies every unchanged match.

AR_snapshot.description: Preview snapshot digest required by apply.

replace.description: Replace text within a captured metavariable.
Literal or regular-expression text to replace.

substring.description: Select a character range from a captured metavariable.

endChar.description: Exclusive zero-based end character; omit for end.

startChar.description: Inclusive zero-based start character; omit for start.

convert.description: Convert a captured metavariable to a named case.

toCase.description: Applied after source capture and before template substitution.

cursor.description: Opaque runtime cursor; preserve it unchanged when supplied.

query.description: Validated follow-up input; run unchanged instead of reconstructing pagination fields.

id.description: Correlation key preserved across every result in the batch.

questions.description: Every atomic question is applied to every resource page, producing one correlated cell per resource/question pair. If it does not apply to all resources, split the matrix. More questions increase provider work; stage excess or dependent questions after the first results.
